+ * Create the transactions of all rules for `month` that are missing. Idempotent: a
+ * month is recorded in the rule's `generated` list, so reopening it (or deleting one
+ * occurrence) never creates duplicates. Returns the same object when nothing changed.
+export function materialise(data: AppData, month: string): AppData {
+    if (month <= r.startMonth || (r.endMonth && month >= r.endMonth) || r.generated.includes(month)) return r
+      transactions.push({ id, type: r.type, cents: r.cents, categoryId: r.categoryId, note: r.note, date: dateForDay(month, r.day), recurringId: r.id })
+/** Stop a rule from `from` (YYYY-MM) on: remove occurrences from that month on, keep earlier months. */
+export function stopRule(data: AppData, ruleId: string, from: string): AppData {
+  const f = from < rule.startMonth ? rule.startMonth : from
+        ? { ...r, endMonth: r.endMonth && r.endMonth < f ? r.endMonth : f, generated: r.generated.filter((m) => m < f) }
+/** Save (add or replace) a transaction and apply the "repeat monthly" choice. */
+export function applyTx(data: AppData, t: Transaction, repeat: boolean): AppData {
+      { id, type: t.type, cents: t.cents, categoryId: t.categoryId, note: t.note, day: Number(t.date.slice(8, 10)), startMonth: month, generated: [month] },
+  const rule = tx.recurringId ? next.recurring.find((r) => r.id === tx.recurringId) : undefined
+    if (!repeat && repeating) next = stopRule(next, rule.id, shiftMonth(month, 1))
+    // Re-enable a stopped rule from this occurrence on
+      next = { ...next, recurring: next.recurring.map((r) => (r.id === rule.id ? { ...r, endMonth: undefined, generated: r.generated.filter((m) => m <= month) } : r)) }

import { expect, test, type Page } from '@playwright/test'
import fs from 'node:fs'

const sizes = [
  { name: 'desktop', width: 1280, height: 800 },
  { name: 'mobile', width: 375, height: 700 },
]

const label = (p: Page) => p.getByTestId('month-label')
async function go(page: Page, dir: 'Previous' | 'Next', n: number) {
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) await page.getByRole('button', { name: `${dir} month` }).click()
}
async function goTo(page: Page, text: string) {
  for (let i = 0; i < 40 && (await label(page).innerText()) !== text; i++) {
    const cur = new Date(`1 ${await label(page).innerText()}`)
    const tgt = new Date(`1 ${text}`)
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: tgt < cur ? 'Previous month' : 'Next month' }).click()
  }
  await expect(label(page)).toHaveText(text)
}

for (const s of sizes) {
  test(`recurring @ ${s.name}`, async ({ page }) => {
    await page.setViewportSize({ width: s.width, height: s.height })
    await page.goto('/')
    await page.evaluate(() => localStorage.clear())
    await page.reload()
    fs.mkdirSync('shots', { recursive: true })
    const rows = page.getByTestId('tx-row')
    const dlg = page.getByRole('dialog')
    const noOverflow = () => page.evaluate(() => document.documentElement.scrollWidth <= window.innerWidth)

    // Add a monthly expense dated Jan 31 (from the month currently viewed)
    await goTo(page, 'January 2026')
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: '+ Add transaction' }).click()
    await expect(dlg.getByLabel('Repeat monthly')).not.toBeChecked()
    await dlg.getByLabel('Amount').fill('50')
    await dlg.getByLabel('Date').fill('2026-01-31')
    await dlg.getByLabel(/Note/).fill('Gym')
    await dlg.getByLabel('Repeat monthly').check()
    await page.screenshot({ path: `shots/${s.name}-repeat-dialog.png` })
    await dlg.getByRole('button', { name: 'Save' }).click()
    await expect(rows).toHaveCount(1)
    await expect(rows.first().getByLabel('Recurring')).toBeVisible()

    // Later months get it automatically on the same day, clamped
    for (const [m, date] of [['February 2026', '2026-02-28'], ['March 2026', '2026-03-31'], ['April 2026', '2026-04-30']]) {
      await goTo(page, m)
      await expect(rows).toHaveCount(1)
      await expect(rows.first()).toContainText(date)
      await expect(rows.first()).toContainText('Gym')
      await expect(page.getByTestId('total-expenses')).toHaveText('50.00')
    }
    // Earlier month than the start has nothing
    await goTo(page, 'December 2025')
    await expect(rows).toHaveCount(0)

    // No duplicates when reopening, or after a reload
    await goTo(page, 'February 2026')
    await go(page, 'Next', 1)
    await go(page, 'Previous', 1)
    await expect(rows).toHaveCount(1)
    await page.reload()
    await goTo(page, 'February 2026')
    await expect(rows).toHaveCount(1)
    await expect(page.getByTestId('total-expenses')).toHaveText('50.00')

    // Leap year clamp (Feb 2028 -> 29th)
    await goTo(page, 'February 2028')
    await expect(rows.first()).toContainText('2028-02-29')

    // Recurring screen
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Recurring', exact: true }).click()
    const rule = page.getByTestId('rule-row')
    await expect(rule).toHaveCount(1)
    await expect(rule).toContainText('Gym')
    await expect(rule).toContainText('Day 31 of each month')
    await expect(page.getByTestId('rule-status')).toHaveText('Active')
    await page.screenshot({ path: `shots/${s.name}-recurring.png` })
    expect(await noOverflow()).toBe(true)

    // Stop from March 2026
    await rule.getByLabel(/from month/).selectOption({ label: 'March 2026' })
    page.once('dialog', (d) => d.accept())
    await rule.getByRole('button', { name: /^Stop/ }).click()
    await expect(page.getByTestId('rule-status')).toHaveText('Stopped from March 2026. Earlier months are unchanged.')
    await page.screenshot({ path: `shots/${s.name}-recurring-stopped.png` })

    // Months before unchanged, from March on gone (also the one we opened before)
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Month', exact: true }).click()
    await goTo(page, 'January 2026')
    await expect(rows).toHaveCount(1)
    await goTo(page, 'February 2026')
    await expect(rows).toHaveCount(1)
    await expect(rows.first()).toContainText('2026-02-28')
    await goTo(page, 'March 2026')
    await expect(rows).toHaveCount(0)
    await goTo(page, 'April 2026')
    await expect(rows).toHaveCount(0)
    await goTo(page, 'August 2026')
    await expect(rows).toHaveCount(0)

    // Stop survives reload
    await page.reload()
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Recurring', exact: true }).click()
    await expect(page.getByTestId('rule-status')).toContainText('Stopped from March 2026')

    // Edit path: repeating income from an existing plain transaction, then uncheck
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Month', exact: true }).click()
    await goTo(page, 'June 2026')
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: '+ Add transaction' }).click()
    await dlg.getByRole('radio', { name: 'income' }).click()
    await dlg.getByLabel('Amount').fill('100.10')
    await dlg.getByLabel('Date').fill('2026-06-15')
    await dlg.getByRole('button', { name: 'Save' }).click()
    await expect(rows.first().getByLabel('Recurring')).toHaveCount(0)
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: /^Edit/ }).click()
    await dlg.getByLabel('Repeat monthly').check()
    await dlg.getByRole('button', { name: 'Save' }).click()
    await expect(rows.first().getByLabel('Recurring')).toBeVisible()
    await goTo(page, 'July 2026')
    await expect(rows.first()).toContainText('2026-07-15')
    await expect(page.getByTestId('total-income')).toHaveText('100.10')
    // Edit the July occurrence: it shows as repeating; uncheck stops from August
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: /^Edit/ }).click()
    await expect(dlg.getByLabel('Repeat monthly')).toBeChecked()
    await dlg.getByLabel('Repeat monthly').uncheck()
    await dlg.getByRole('button', { name: 'Save' }).click()
    await goTo(page, 'August 2026')
    await expect(rows).toHaveCount(0)
    await goTo(page, 'June 2026')
    await expect(rows).toHaveCount(1)
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Recurring', exact: true }).click()
    await expect(page.getByTestId('rule-row')).toHaveCount(2)
    await expect(page.getByTestId('rule-row').filter({ hasText: 'Stopped' })).toHaveCount(2)
    await page.setViewportSize({ width: s.width, height: s.height })
    expect(await noOverflow()).toBe(true)
  })
}

    await goTo(page, 'June 2026')
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: '+ Add transaction' }).click()
    await dlg.getByRole('radio', { name: 'income' }).click()
    await dlg.getByLabel('Amount').fill('100.10')
    await dlg.getByLabel('Date').fill('2026-06-15')
    await dlg.getByRole('button', { name: 'Save' }).click()
    await expect(rows.first().getByLabel('Recurring')).toHaveCount(0)
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: /^Edit/ }).click()
    await dlg.getByLabel('Repeat monthly').check()
    await dlg.getByRole('button', { name: 'Save' }).click()
    await expect(rows.first().getByLabel('Recurring')).toBeVisible()
    await goTo(page, 'July 2026')
    await expect(rows.first()).toContainText('2026-07-15')
    await expect(page.getByTestId('total-income')).toHaveText('100.10')
    // Edit the July occurrence: it shows as repeating; uncheck stops from August
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: /^Edit/ }).click()
    await expect(dlg.getByLabel('Repeat monthly')).toBeChecked()
    await dlg.getByLabel('Repeat monthly').uncheck()
    await dlg.getByRole('button', { name: 'Save' }).click()
    await goTo(page, 'August 2026')
    await expect(rows).toHaveCount(0)
    await goTo(page, 'June 2026')
    await expect(rows).toHaveCount(1)
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Recurring', exact: true }).click()
    await expect(page.getByTestId('rule-row')).toHaveCount(2)
    await expect(page.getByTestId('rule-row').filter({ hasText: 'Stopped' })).toHaveCount(2)
    await page.setViewportSize({ width: s.width, height: s.height })
    expect(await noOverflow()).toBe(true)
  })
}

content.text: Everything passes. Now a visual check of the new screens.
The Recurring screen looks right at both sizes. I also need to check the main Month screen, since the header now has the tabs.

Repeating monthly transactions are in. The new logic tests (34 in total now) and 4 browser tests, 2 at each width, all pass, and `tsc` and `oxlint` are clean.

**How it behaves**
- **Repeat monthly:** the add/edit dialog has a "Repeat monthly" checkbox. Ticking it on a new or an existing transaction makes it repeat.
- **Later months:** a repeating transaction appears in each later month when you open it, on the same day. A rule set on the 31st gives Feb 28 (29 in leap years), Apr 30 and Mar 31 again. Opening a month again, or reloading, never creates a second copy.
- **Recurring screen:** a new "Recurring" tab lists every repeating transaction with its day, start month and status. "Stop from [month]" asks you to confirm. Months before the chosen one stay unchanged; that month and later ones lose their copies. Stopped rules stay listed as "Stopped from …".
- **Marker:** repeating transactions show a ↻ in the list.

**Choices I made where you didn't specify**
- **Editing one month:** editing an occurrence changes only that month. To change the amount for future months, stop the rule and add a new one.
- **Unticking the box:** unticking "Repeat monthly" on an occurrence stops the rule from the next month on. Re-ticking it on the last occurrence resumes the rule.
- **Deleting one month:** deleting one occurrence removes only that month's copy, and it doesn't come back when you reopen the month.
- **Months you skip:** only the month you open gets its copy, so skipped months aren't back-filled. Each month's totals don't depend on the others, so nothing is lost.

**What I tested and how**
- **Logic tests (`npx vitest run`, 34 passing, 18 of them new):**
  - Day clamping for 28, 29 (leap year), 30 and 31-day months.
  - Creating a rule from a new or an existing transaction.
  - Later months appear, with no duplicates on reopening, no copy in the start month or before it, and no regeneration of a deleted copy.
  - Stopping keeps earlier months, removes the chosen month on, and can't be extended by a second stop.
  - Unticking, re-ticking and editing one occurrence.
  - Saving rules to storage, and loading old saved data that has no rules.
- **Browser tests (`npx playwright test`, real Chrome at 1280px and 375px):**
  - Added a "Gym" expense dated Jan 31 with Repeat monthly ticked. Feb showed 2026-02-28, Mar 03-31 and Apr 04-30, each with a 50.00 total. Dec 2025 had nothing, and Feb 2028 showed the 29th.
  - Reopened Feb and reloaded the page; both times there was still one copy.
  - On the Recurring screen, checked the day text and "Active", stopped it from March 2026 after the confirmation, and saw "Stopped from March 2026". Jan and Feb still had their copies and Mar, Apr and Aug were empty. The stop survived a reload.
  - Added a plain income and then ticked repeat on it. It appeared in July with 100.10 in the income total, and unticking it from the July copy removed August.
  - Checked there is no sideways scrolling on the Recurring screen at either width.
- **Screenshots:** I opened the repeat dialog and the Recurring screen (active and stopped) at both sizes, plus the Month screen on mobile. All laid out correctly.
- **Existing tests:** the earlier walkthrough tests still pass.

I found one bug while writing the tests: a repeating transaction dated in an earlier month didn't show up in the month already open until you navigated away and back. It now appears immediately.
